steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker, after the tires have cooled.
Park somewhere safe and apply the parking brake firmly. The system will not take the new setting while the car is moving.
Press and hold the tire pressure monitoring system set switch.
Let go once the tire pressure warning light in the gauges flashes twice and you hear one beep. That means the new pressures were accepted.
tpms.note: Do this again whenever you adjust the pressures or rotate or replace tires. If the light stays on after this and some driving, have the system checked.
